nodes.name: Campaign To Search
nodes.notes: Edit campaign_id to the real campaign row you want to search for before running.

nodes.name: Get Campaign
nodes.notes: Attach a Supabase credential (Project URL + service_role key). LEGACY: reads a `campaign` table shape that predates the current schema.

nodes.name: Build Search Params
nodes.notes: Attach an HTTP Header Auth credential named 'OpenRouter' (Authorization: Bearer <key>). Model: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free (mistral's free tier was deprecated).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "model": "nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free", "messages": [ { "role": "system", "content": "You translate a plain-English LinkedIn search goal into search parameters for a profile-search tool. Output ONLY valid JSON in exactly this shape: {\"searchQuery\": \"short keyword phrase capturing the core topic\", \"locations\": [\"city or region name(s) mentioned, empty array if none\"], \"currentJobTitles\": [\"likely job title(s) implied by the goal, empty array if none\"], \"maxItems\": 25}. Keep arrays short (1-3 entries), plain strings a LinkedIn search would recognize. No other keys, no prose." }, { "role": "user", "content": "Search goal: " + $json.search_goal } ], "response_format": { "type": "json_object" } } }}

nodes.name: Search Apify
nodes.notes: Attach an HTTP Header Auth credential named 'Apify' (Authorization: Bearer <Apify API token>). Runs harvestapi/linkedin-profile-search synchronously and returns dataset items directly (see RESEARCH-NOTES.md for why this actor was picked).

nodes.name: Normalize Profiles
nodes.notes: Confirmed against a real run (2026-08-28): harvestapi's linkedinUrl/fullName-fallback/headline mappings were already correct. location needed a fix - it comes back as an object ({linkedinText, countryCode, parsed}), not a string; now extracts linkedinText. raw_data always keeps the full original item regardless.

nodes.name: Save Profiles
nodes.notes: One row per found profile. LEGACY: writes to a `profile` table that predates the current person/external_profile/profile_snapshot schema.
